datasets.name: ODSRepGroupAllNB
datasets.sql:
SELECT  
g.id,
g.name,
g.amort as percent,
g.taxamort as tax_percent,
w.groups_id,
w.amort_date,
sum(w.first_price) as first_price,
sum(w.remainder) as remainder,
sum(w.all_amort) as all_amort,
sum(w.amort) as amort,
sum(w.tax_first_price) as tax_first_price,
sum(w.tax_remainder) as tax_remainder,
sum(w.tax_all_amort) as tax_all_amort,
sum(w.tax_amort) as tax_amort

FROM 
       wares_last w,groups g

WHERE 
        g.id=w.groups_id
      and
        amort_date between :v_amort_date and :end_date

GROUP BY 
        g.id,
        g.name,
        g.amort,
        g.taxamort,
        w.groups_id,
        w.amort_date 
ORDER BY
         name,amort_date,first_price

datasets.name: ODSArWaresS
datasets.sql:
SELECT ROWNUM, w.*
  FROM wares_all w
 WHERE close_format = 2
   AND ((tax_remainder <= first_price * 5 / 100) OR (tax_first_price < 100))
   AND groups_id = :groups_id

datasets.name: ODSArWaresReport
datasets.sql:
select g.name,g.id,rownum,w.* from groups g,wares_all w where g.id=w.groups_id
and w.close_format = 2

datasets.sql:
select  c.ACC_NO,c.BAL_CN1,a.WARES_NAME,a.INVENTAR_DATE,a.FIRST_PRICE,a.REMAINDER,
